title: Toto
notes: Precision studio rock blends keyboard hooks, funk-inflected grooves, soulful singing and intricate guitar passages.

title: Hydra
notes: Dramatic progressive-rock passages alternate with crunching riffs, keyboard layers and tender soft-rock songs.

title: Turn Back
notes: Guitar-heavy arena rock places soaring vocals and thick riffs ahead of earlier studio-pop variety.

title: Toto IV
scene: Early-1980s Los Angeles AOR and soft rock
influenced_by: Led Zeppelin (In Through the Out Door)|Steely Dan (Aja)|Steely Dan (Gaucho)|The Beach Boys|The Beatles|Elton John
notes: Lush studio precision frames melodic ballads, elastic shuffle rhythms, layered voices and distinctive synth textures.

title: Isolation
scene: Mid-1980s Los Angeles arena rock and AOR
notes: Guitar-forward arena rock, urgent high tenor, vivid keyboards and occasional orchestral colour.

title: Dune
notes: Brooding orchestral science fiction with rock accents; Eno contributes one distinct ambient track.

title: Fahrenheit
scene: 1980s Los Angeles pop-rock and R&B crossover
notes: Soulful Joseph Williams vocals, keyboard-rich funk, romantic ballads and a jazz-instrumental finale.

title: The Seventh One
scene: 1988 Los Angeles studio AOR and polished pop-rock
notes: Rich brass arrangements and melodic AOR balance warm percussion, intricate grooves and soaring choruses.
